observations: All 11 current sheets were actually opened and inspected. They cover 33 Hero/Normal cases, six angles each (front, left, right, back, above, below): nine specializations at fresh, half and mature age, plus 25/50/75% Run+Fly and Power+Swim influence states.

The white original cubic head, rectangular face/eyes, compact hands/feet and shared attachment-bearing limbs retain a coherent blocky silhouette. There is no visually apparent skull stretching or extra head replacement in this scope. The exact 7x6x6 numeric invariant belongs to separate rig/source checks, not an image measurement.

Two-part top features remain recognizable: white lower roots, blue/variant upper caps; mature Run is long and slim, Power broad and blunt, Fly has notably thin white stems with substantial lavender caps, Swim has broad cyan/mint caps. Mixed forms have proportion and color differences rather than only the same recolored sticks.

Fresh states stay similar; age50 states and quarter-influence sheets show connected intermediate shapes. There is no visible detached cap, exposed internal face or new coplanar striped pattern at the inspected root/cap joins. Mature Power+Swim front/back and age50 front were reopened at original resolution for this check.

Mature Run+Swim front was reopened at original resolution: broad paired cyan/blue caps meet the white roots continuously and retain halo clearance. Mature Fly front was reopened: both thin white stalks visibly connect head to the caps rather than floating bulb pieces.

From side/back/above/below, halo stays clear of the top features at the sampled poses. Mature Swim left has a narrow positive-looking halo gap; these static frames do not quantify a minimum dynamic clearance.

The wing fronts/backs/edges in these sampled views are solid visible blocky surfaces with white inner regions and variant distal pigments; no opaque empty-frame border is visible. The long mint Run wing, short golden Power wing and broader white/yellow Fly and Swim wings are distinguishable. Mature Run back was reopened at original resolution.

The current live-viewer principal sheet and findings were read as comparison evidence: tall Run/Swim, blunt Power, thin-stalk Fly, variant wing pigments and white base align with those qualitative references. This reviewer did not independently operate the viewer; no exact mesh match is claimed.
limitations: This is a read-only visual audit of the final post-depth client cohort. It did not invoke a build, run a new Minecraft client, operate the browser, alter production source or perform interactive gameplay.

All 198 Hero originals were personally inspected through uniform crop/resize sheets; only the nine listed originals were additionally reopened at full resolution. Crops and labels are review aids, not new renderer output.

Static snapshots at six angles establish sampled appearance only. Continuous growth, frame-to-frame popping, fast wing flaps, moving accessory contacts, phone graphics, touch controls, networking, permissions and save/reload require separate parent checks.

Ordinary white-coat Hero/Normal cases in this scope do not prove every inherited coat/shiny material, animal/hats/toys/player-carry combination, other first types, Dark forms or all possible stat mixtures. Other cohorts and tests must carry those claims.

Hero cuboid points, rectangular caps/halos and blocky wings deliberately approximate smooth viewer features. Blinks, head pose and limb phase can differ between captures because production animation runs; fixtures are raised to allow below-camera views. Neither difference is evidence of changed biology or a new rig defect.
